comment: Layer-C integration case for weno5_advection (div(U*q), O(h^5) WENO5 flux divergence). Converts the truncation-only (Layer-B) coverage into a solved trajectory via the freeze-and-accumulate pattern: the field-level pipeline (build_ode_problem) integrates a state that accumulates the WENO5 flux divergence of a frozen U*q, and verifies high-order spatial convergence against the analytic flux divergence.
